Deviation alerts are isolated, transient, and involve only 1-3 sensors at a time (e.g., sensor_9 spikes at cycles 162, 182, 187; sensor_14 at cycles 157, 168, 191; sensor_2 at cycles 152, 183). No sustained multi-sensor degradation trend appears. This engine shows no such pattern. Therefore, it remains in the healthy regime with RUL at the 125-cycle cap.
